critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/guardian/speak-line correctly caps text via Pydantic (SpeakLineIn max_length=200), so 422 fires before the rate limiter — confirmed empirically. Same by-design behaviour as /guardian/chat-once from iteration 12.
auth.tsx refresh(): auto demo-login remains the critical path for judges. Verified fires on every fresh load; localStorage.clear() + navigate reproduces the 200 POST /api/auth/demo consistently.

cinematic-hub.tsx guardian-subtitle useEffect: gated on `audio.voice` truthy AND `greet=true`; verified subtitle rendered even under browser autoplay policy (guardian-tts.ts defers audio to pointerdown but the subtitle is decoupled from actual playback start).

scorecard.tsx narration useEffect: waits for `token` before POSTing /api/guardian/speak-line — this correctly avoids the 401 that would otherwise fire if the demo-token round-trip hadn't finished before the screen mounts.
launch-sequence.tsx: pickWebSrc() codec probe correctly selects webm in headless Chromium (which has no H.264). Entrance video onError swap to webm is the safety net; verified currentSrc=…-hd.webm.

judge-demo.tsx (435 lines): file is at the split-threshold; consider extracting STAGES data array (~120 lines of scene copy) into a data module if this grows further. Currently within acceptable range.
Console-only CanvasKit warning ('Failed to fetch') is a benign RN-Web skia-fallback in this preview; app renders correctly on the plain web canvas.
seed_data_creation: TestAuthDemo mints one demo session per module (users + user_sessions doc in Mongo). TestSpeakLine + TestScorecardImage reuse that single session so they consume ~2 speak-line + 1 share-image budget slots. No stale data left behind beyond the one demo user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 verifies the complete cinematic judge journey end-to-end after the judge-demo.tsx rewrite. Playwright Chromium always picks the webm fallback — that is expected. If retesting soon, note that the share-image bucket is 10/min/user and the tts user bucket is 30/min — normal single-pass tests never trip them. The provided demo-token in iteration_12 (demo_bcd24315c8ea45148e96e87a30a4586d) is now 24h+ stale; iteration_13 mints its own via /api/auth/demo. Frontend confirmed at 390x844 mobile viewport. All rate-limit budgets, memory highlight recall on portal-return (session visit tracking), and the memory-consent 'first-time vs return' portal-intro branch remain covered by iteration_11+_12 reports.
